blocks.text: SOP: cycle count during first break, dry forward

This is the working cut for PCF-SOP-2024-052 on May 16, 2024. Lila Voss asked for a written bound after the current path (RF shows qty, people tap confirm) stopped being honest. I am Jeilen Jones, Order Picker, writing for Marcus Hale, Tasha Quinn, and Ben Crowe. Primary host slot.pinecrest.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on count with the system qty showing, then open questions. If you are on the floor next shift, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the steps.

Blind count. Location frozen. No pick into a frozen bin. Variance over 3 units pages Lila. I am not restating a hallway yes. count with the system qty showing is out because April 25 'count' confirmed a ghost 40 on SKU 4418. Pick went short all morning. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: ghost=40, sku=4418, var=3, freeze=12, weeks=2, bins=18.4, shorts=6.2, firstbreak=09:10. Sibling tickets PCF-1744 and PCF-INC-2024-061. I will not reopen count with the system qty showing in a side thread because someone asked for a rate waiver. Tasha Quinn is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.

blocks.text: Background. Why the current path is the wrong tool

Ben Crowe owns a leftover that is easy to skip: aisle-b2.pinecrest.internal. I will ping once. After that the owner is late, not blocked. Unique to this file (12): refuse on count with the system qty showing, lock is blind, freeze, 3-unit page. I will not hide a process change inside a 'quick align' on PCF-1744.
If you count with the WMS number on the screen, you will confirm the lie.

What a skeptical lead would try first on slot.pinecrest.internal: the path Lila Voss actually has, not an empty-tote photo. Metric I will argue is a clean confirm, not a vanity units-per-hour. If we cannot show that path on wms.pinecrest.internal with the numbers already in this file, we do not have a cut. Jeilen Jones will not accept a hallway yes as that proof.
Constraints and the lock
